_note: How hard each question is, 1 (easy) to 4 (hardest), judged by eye from the figures. 1: two plain figures put together; 2: two figures with a few lines each; 3: figures with many lines or curves, where the options differ by one line; 4: one figure turned before it is put on the other. Practice and Classroom ask the questions in this order (lib/levels.ts). Questions marked needs-review have none. tools/check_levels.ts checks them.
